headlines.title: Honeywell (HON) Stock May Sit Above Fair Value On Raised Outlook
headlines.summary: Honeywell International has seen its share price fall about 44% year to date, even as fresh headlines around its businesses keep coming, which puts the spotlight squarely on whether the current US$219.26 level lines up with the cash the company can generate over time. With a Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) view available, the question now is how that intrinsic value estimate compares with a stock that shows both long term gains and a sharp recent pullback.

headlines.title: Honeywell International (HON) Unit Set Its First Standalone Quarterly Dividend
headlines.summary: Honeywell International (NasdaqGS:HON) unit Honeywell Aerospace declared its first standalone quarterly cash dividend after separating from Honeywell Technologies. The aerospace business approved the inaugural payout as a regular quarterly distribution to shareholders following its corporate separation. Honeywell Aerospace plans to build a new advanced manufacturing facility in Arizona to support commercial aviation and defense demand.

headlines.title: Honeywell Technologies Helps Royal Caribbean Personalize the Guest Experience With Connected Cabin Automation System
headlines.summary: ATLANTA, October 29, 2026--Honeywell Technologies' (NASDAQ: HON) connected cabin automation system is now powering more than 8,400 staterooms aboard Royal Caribbean’s three in-service Icon Class ships – the world's most innovative cruise ships. The deployment delivers automated comfort, convenience and efficiency to hundreds of thousands of passengers annually while helping crews operate ships more efficiently.

description: Honeywell International Inc. engages in the industrial automation, building automation, and energy and sustainability solutions businesses in the United States, Europe, and internationally. The Industrial Automation segment provides automation control and instrumentation products and services; smart energy products; sensing technologies, including custom-engineered sensors and related services; gas detection technologies and personal protective equipment; and system design automation equipment, as well as software and analytics for manufacturing, distribution, and fulfillment operations. The Building Automation segment provides software applications for building control and optimization; sensors, switches, control systems, and instruments for energy management; access control; video surveillance; fire products; and installation, maintenance, and system upgrade services. The Energy and Sustainability Solutions segment, through its UOP business, delivers licensed process technology, equipment, engineering, catalysts, adsorbents, and services for refining, petrochemicals, low-carbon energy, gas and LNG, and industrial solutions, as well as connectivity, data integration, and software solutions. The company also offers Forge Cognition, a self-contained agentic AI and simulation platform for facility operations. The company was formerly known as AlliedSignal, Inc. Honeywell International Inc. was founded in 1885 and is headquartered in Charlotte, North Carolina.
